name: TruePeopleSearch

search.notes: Search page answered with a captcha page on 2026-10-27, so the pattern is not confirmed.

steps: Open the removal page, enter an email, accept the terms and complete the captcha yourself.
Search by name, city and state inside the removal flow.
Open the matching record and choose to remove it.
Click the link in the verification email.
optout.notes: identity-eraser says copies on other top-level domains need their own opt-outs. The 2026 California registry lists the site under Free Data Services, LLC.
